summary.en: Flyweight makes objects lightweight when you have too many of them by splitting their data into intrinsic (shared, context-free) state and extrinsic (instance-specific) state. One copy of the intrinsic state is shared everywhere the object appears — from tree models sent once to the GPU via instanced rendering, to terrain objects referenced by pointer from every tile.
summary.zh: 当对象数量过多时，享元模式通过把对象的数据拆分为内在状态（可共享、与上下文无关）和外在状态（每个实例独有），让对象变得“轻量”。内在状态只保留一份，在对象出现的每个地方共享——从借助实例化渲染只向 GPU 发送一次的树木模型，到每个地块通过指针引用的地形对象，都是这样。

title.en: A modest name for majestic scenes
title.zh: 名字朴素，却成就壮丽场景

body.en: A vast old-growth forest of countless trees is the kind of otherworldly setting game developers dream of. Scenes like this are often made possible by a pattern with a very modest name: the humble Flyweight.
body.zh: 由无数古树组成的辽阔原始森林，正是游戏开发者梦寐以求的奇幻场景。而这类场景往往是靠一个名字极其朴素的模式实现的：不起眼的享元模式。

title.en: Too much data for the GPU
title.zh: 要送往 GPU 的数据太多

body.en: A forest means thousands of trees, each with thousands of polygons. Even if memory suffices, the data must travel over the bus from CPU to GPU every frame. Each tree has a mesh, bark and leaf textures, a position and orientation, and tuning parameters like size and tint — the mesh and textures being especially large.
body.zh: 一片森林意味着成千上万棵树，每棵树又有成千上万个多边形。即使内存足够，这些数据每帧都得经由总线从 CPU 传到 GPU。每棵树都有网格、树皮与树叶纹理、位置和朝向，以及大小、色调等调节参数——其中网格和纹理尤其庞大。

body.en: The key observation: although there are thousands of trees, they mostly look similar and likely use the same mesh and textures. So most fields are identical across instances. We split the object in two, moving the shared data into a TreeModel of which the game needs only one.
body.zh: 关键的观察是：虽然森林里有成千上万棵树，但它们大多长得很像，很可能使用相同的网格和纹理。因此大部分字段在所有实例中都相同。于是我们把对象一分为二，把共享数据移到 TreeModel 中，整个游戏只需要一个 TreeModel。

title.zh: 享元模式与类型对象模式

body.en: This resembles the Type Object pattern: both delegate part of an object's state to another object shared by many instances. But their intents differ: Type Object aims to minimize the number of classes by lifting "types" into your own object model, with memory sharing as a bonus; Flyweight is purely about efficiency.
body.zh: 这看起来很像类型对象（Type Object）模式：两者都把对象的一部分状态委托给由多个实例共享的另一个对象。但它们的意图不同：类型对象旨在把“类型”提升到自己的对象模型中，以减少需要定义的类，内存共享只是附带好处；而享元模式纯粹是为了效率。

body.en: Sharing in main memory doesn't help rendering; the GPU must understand the sharing too. Direct3D and OpenGL support instanced rendering: you supply two streams — the common data (mesh and textures) rendered many times, and a list of instances with their parameters (position, color, scale). With a single draw call, an entire forest grows.
body.zh: 在主存中共享并不能帮助渲染，GPU 也必须理解这种共享。Direct3D 和 OpenGL 都支持实例化渲染：你提供两路数据流——一路是要被多次渲染的公共数据（网格和纹理），另一路是实例列表及其参数（位置、颜色、缩放）。只需一次绘制调用，整片森林便拔地而起。

title.en: Hardware support for a GoF pattern
title.zh: 有硬件支持的 GoF 模式

body.en: Because instanced rendering is implemented directly by the graphics card, Flyweight may be the only Gang of Four design pattern with actual hardware support.
body.zh: 由于实例化渲染直接由显卡实现，享元模式可能是唯一一个拥有真正硬件支持的四人帮设计模式。

body.en: Flyweight applies when objects need to be more lightweight, usually because there are too many of them. It splits an object's data in two: intrinsic state, which is not instance-specific and can be shared (the author calls it "context-free"; here the geometry and textures), and extrinsic state, unique to each instance (position, scale, color).
body.zh: 当对象需要更轻量——通常是因为数量太多——时，就可以使用享元模式。它把对象的数据分为两类：内在状态（intrinsic state），不属于某个具体实例、可以共享（作者称之为“与上下文无关”的部分，这里是几何和纹理）；外在状态（extrinsic state），每个实例独有（位置、缩放、颜色）。

title.zh: 共享对象没有明确身份时最巧妙

body.en: The pattern saves memory by sharing one copy of intrinsic state everywhere an object appears. With TreeModel it looks like basic resource sharing because the shared state has a clear identity. It is less obvious and more clever when the shared object has no well-defined identity — it feels like one object is magically in multiple places at once.
body.zh: 该模式通过在对象出现的每个地方共享同一份内在状态来节省内存。在 TreeModel 的例子里，共享状态有清晰的独立身份，所以看起来只是普通的资源共享。而当共享对象没有明确的身份时，这个模式就不那么显而易见、也更巧妙——感觉就像同一个对象神奇地同时出现在多个地方。

title.en: A Place To Put Down Roots

body.en: The ground is a grid of tiles, each covered by one terrain type with properties: movement cost, whether it's water, and a texture. To avoid storing all that per tile, a common approach is an enum per tile, with switch statements in World methods to look up each property.
body.zh: 地面是由地块组成的网格，每个地块覆盖一种地形，而地形有若干属性：移动消耗、是否为水域、渲染用的纹理。为了避免在每个地块中存储这些数据，常见做法是每个地块存一个枚举值，再在 World 的方法里用 switch 语句查询各个属性。

title.zh: 数据散落在各个方法中

body.en: This works but is ugly: movement cost and wetness are data about a terrain, yet they're embedded in code, and a single terrain's data is smeared across many methods. It would be better to encapsulate it together in a Terrain class — that's what objects are for.
body.zh: 这样可行，但很丑陋：移动消耗和是否为水域本是地形的数据，却被写死在代码里，而且同一种地形的数据分散在一堆方法中。更好的做法是把它们封装到一个 Terrain 类里——这本来就是对象的用途。

title.zh: 享元对象几乎总是不可变的

body.en: All of Terrain's methods are const, and that's no coincidence. Since the same object is used in multiple contexts, modifying it would change it in many places at once. Sharing to save memory should be an optimization that doesn't affect visible behavior, so flyweight objects are almost always immutable.
body.zh: Terrain 的所有方法都是 const 的，这并非巧合。同一个对象被用于多个上下文，修改它就会同时改变多个地方。为节省内存而共享对象应当是一种不影响可见行为的优化，因此享元对象几乎总是不可变的。

title.en: A grid of pointers to shared terrains
title.zh: 指向共享地形的指针网格

body.en: Nothing in Terrain depends on a tile's location — all its state is intrinsic — so one instance per terrain type suffices. The world becomes a grid of Terrain pointers; tiles of the same terrain point to the same instance. The instances are stored directly in World to avoid complex lifetime management of dynamic allocation.
body.zh: Terrain 中没有任何与地块位置相关的数据——它的所有状态都是内在的——所以每种地形只需一个实例。世界于是变成一个 Terrain 指针的网格，相同地形的地块指向同一个实例。这些实例直接存放在 World 中，以免动态分配带来复杂的生命周期管理。

title.zh: 几乎零开销的对象接口

body.en: World can now expose the Terrain object directly via getTile(), so World is no longer coupled to terrain details. We're back to the pleasant API of real objects with almost no overhead, since a pointer is often no larger than an enum.
body.zh: 现在 World 可以通过 getTile() 直接暴露 Terrain 对象，World 不再与地形的各种细节耦合。我们重新获得了使用真正对象的舒适接口，而且几乎没有额外开销，因为指针通常并不比枚举大。

title.en: Pointer chasing may cause cache misses
title.zh: 指针追踪可能导致缓存未命中

body.en: Referencing terrain by pointer means an indirect lookup: follow the pointer to the Terrain object, then read the movement cost. Chasing a pointer can cause a cache miss and slow things down (see the Data Locality chapter).
body.zh: 通过指针引用地形意味着间接查找：先沿指针找到 Terrain 对象，再读取移动消耗。这种指针追踪可能导致缓存未命中，从而拖慢速度（详见“数据局部性”一章）。

body.en: The golden rule of optimization is profile first; modern hardware is too complex to reason about performance purely. In the author's tests, flyweights had no penalty over enums and were even noticeably faster, though that depends on memory layout. If you're creating an enum and switching on it a lot, consider Flyweight instead.
body.zh: 优化的黄金法则是先做性能分析；现代硬件过于复杂，性能已无法单凭推理判断。在作者的测试中，享元相比枚举没有任何性能损失，甚至明显更快，不过这完全取决于其他数据在内存中的布局。如果你发现自己创建了一个枚举并对它大量使用 switch，不妨考虑享元模式。

body.en: If you can't predict which flyweights you'll need, create them on demand: when one is requested, check whether an identical one already exists and return it. This means hiding construction behind an interface — an example of the Factory Method pattern — and keeping track of created flyweights, for which an Object Pool is a natural home.
body.zh: 如果无法预知需要哪些享元，就按需创建：请求某个享元时，先检查是否已经创建过相同的实例，有就直接返回。这意味着要把构造过程隐藏在某个接口之后——这是工厂方法（Factory Method）模式的一个例子——并记录已经创建的享元，对象池（Object Pool）正适合用来存放它们。

body.en: In the State pattern, state objects often have no fields specific to the machine using them; their identity and methods suffice. Such states can be flyweights, reused across many state machines at the same time without problems.
body.zh: 在状态（State）模式中，状态对象通常没有任何与所在状态机相关的字段，仅凭它的身份和方法就足够了。这样的状态可以作为享元，同时在多个状态机中复用而不会出问题。

exercises.q: The shared, context-free data in a flyweight is called ___ state; 每个实例独有的数据称为 extrinsic state。
exercises.explain: Intrinsic state（内在状态）可共享，如树的网格与纹理；extrinsic state（外在状态）如位置、缩放、颜色。

exercises.q: In the forest example, which data moves into the shared TreeModel? 哪些数据放进 TreeModel？
options: Mesh, bark texture and leaf texture（网格与纹理）
exercises.explain: 网格和纹理在所有树之间相同且体积大，只需一份；位置、高度、色调等是每棵树独有的。

exercises.q: 享元模式和 Type Object 模式的主要区别是什么？ What differs between them?
options: Flyweight shares state; Type Object never does
Their intent: Type Object 旨在减少类的数量，Flyweight 纯粹为了效率
exercises.explain: Both delegate state to a shared object, but Type Object lifts types into your object model; memory sharing is only a bonus there.

exercises.q: Flyweight may be the only GoF pattern with actual hardware support, thanks to instanced rendering. 享元可能是唯一有硬件支持的 GoF 模式。
exercises.explain: True. Direct3D/OpenGL 的实例化渲染由显卡直接实现：一路公共数据 + 一路实例参数，一次 draw call 画出整片森林。

exercises.q: Why are flyweight objects almost always immutable? 为什么享元对象几乎总是不可变的？
options: Because C++ requires shared pointers to be const
因为同一对象在多处共享，修改它会同时影响所有使用它的地方
exercises.explain: Sharing to save memory should be an optimization that doesn't change visible behavior. 共享不应改变程序的可见行为。

exercises.q: What's wrong with representing terrain as an enum plus switch statements in World? 用枚举加 switch 表示地形有什么问题？
exercises.answer: EN: Terrain properties like movement cost and wetness are data but are embedded in code, and one terrain's data is smeared across many methods instead of being encapsulated together; World is also coupled to all terrain details. 中：移动消耗、是否为水域等本是数据，却写死在代码里；同一种地形的数据分散在多个方法中，没有封装在一起，World 也与地形细节耦合。
exercises.explain: 改用 Terrain 对象 + 指针网格，既有面向对象的接口，又几乎没有额外开销。

exercises.q: With flyweights, World stores a grid of ___ to Terrain objects instead of enums. 世界变成指向 Terrain 对象的___网格。
exercises.explain: 相同地形的地块指向同一个 Terrain 实例；指针通常不比枚举大。

exercises.q: 作者的测试表明，享元因为指针间接访问，总是比枚举明显更慢。 Flyweights were always slower than enums in his tests.
exercises.explain: False. In his tests there was no penalty — flyweights were even noticeably faster — but it depends on memory layout. 关键是先 profile。

exercises.q: What is the golden rule of optimization stated in this chapter? 本章提到的优化黄金法则是？
exercises.explain: 现代硬件太复杂，不能靠纯推理判断性能。

exercises.q: 按需创建享元并在已存在时返回旧实例，这种隐藏构造函数的做法是哪个模式的例子？
exercises.explain: Hiding construction behind an interface that first looks for an existing object is Factory Method; an Object Pool can store the created flyweights.
